title: 1-Hour Thames Sightseeing Cruise from Westminster
description: The classic first taste of London from the water. A relaxed 1-hour sightseeing cruise departing from Westminster Pier, gliding past the Houses of Parliament, the London Eye, and under Tower Bridge with live multilingual commentary.
imageAlt: A Thames sightseeing boat passing the Houses of Parliament and Big Ben, London
highlights: Depart right from Westminster Pier, steps from Big Ben
Glide past the Houses of Parliament, the London Eye and Shakespeare's Globe
Sail beneath the iconic Tower Bridge before turning back
Live multilingual commentary pointing out every landmark
Open-air deck seating for unobstructed photos
excludes: Food and drinks (available to purchase onboard)

title: Guided Thames River Cruise with Live Commentary
description: See London's skyline with a knowledgeable onboard guide who brings 2,000 years of river history to life — from the Tower of London to St Paul's Cathedral, with the stories behind every bridge and landmark along the way.
imageAlt: A guide pointing out landmarks to passengers aboard a Thames river cruise boat
bestFor: In-depth history & first-time visitors who want context
highlights: Live guide covering 2,000 years of Thames river history
Pass the Tower of London, Tower Bridge, and St Paul's Cathedral
Hear the stories behind the Globe Theatre and the Golden Hinde
Small group setting for an unhurried, informative cruise
Great photo opportunities at every major landmark

title: Thames Round-Trip Cruise to Greenwich
description: Perfect for travelers who want to see more of the river. Cruise from central London down to historic Greenwich, home of the Cutty Sark, the Royal Observatory, and the Prime Meridian, then sail back with fresh river views.
imageAlt: A river cruise boat approaching Greenwich Pier on the Thames, London
bestFor: Travelers who want to combine a cruise with a Greenwich day trip
priceTableFeature: Greenwich Round-Trip — No Landmark Stops Required
highlights: Cruise the full stretch from central London to Greenwich
Pass Canary Wharf and the O2 Arena along the way
Optional stop at Greenwich Pier to explore the Cutty Sark and Royal Observatory
See London's skyline change from historic to modern and back
Flexible departure times throughout the day
includes: Round-trip Thames cruise ticket, central London to Greenwich
excludes: Greenwich attraction entry fees (Cutty Sark, Royal Observatory)

title: Thames Evening River Cruise with Live Music
description: The same iconic route after dark, with ambient live music onboard and every bridge and landmark lit up along the water — Tower Bridge illuminated, the London Eye glowing, and the city skyline sparkling as you glide past.
imageAlt: Tower Bridge illuminated at night, viewed from a Thames evening cruise boat
bestFor: Couples and evening sightseers who want the city lit up
highlights: See Tower Bridge, the Shard, and the London Eye lit up after dark
Ambient live music playing onboard as you cruise
Open-air deck seating for uninterrupted night views
Cash bar available onboard
A quieter, more relaxed cruise than daytime departures
excludes: Food and drinks (available to purchase onboard)

title: Afternoon Tea Cruise on the Thames
description: An elegant, low-key way to see the river. Enjoy a traditional English afternoon tea — finger sandwiches, scones and pastries — while cruising past Big Ben, the London Eye, and Tower Bridge at a leisurely pace.
imageAlt: A traditional afternoon tea spread served aboard a Thames river cruise boat
bestFor: Special occasions and travelers who want a relaxed, seated experience
highlights: Traditional English afternoon tea served at your seat
Finger sandwiches, scones with clotted cream, and pastries
Leisurely 2-hour cruise past all the major riverside landmarks
Indoor seating with panoramic river-facing windows
A relaxed alternative to a standard sightseeing cruise
includes: Traditional afternoon tea (sandwiches, scones, pastries, tea/coffee)

title: London Thames Full-Day Combo: Cruise, Tower Bridge & Greenwich
description: Experience the best of the river in one seamless day. Includes a Thames sightseeing cruise, entry to the Tower Bridge Exhibition, and a round-trip cruise down to Greenwich to explore the Cutty Sark and Royal Observatory.
imageAlt: Panoramic view of the River Thames, Tower Bridge, and London skyline from above
bestFor: Travelers who want to see the whole river in a single day
highlights: 1-hour Thames sightseeing cruise with live commentary
Skip-the-line entry to the Tower Bridge Exhibition and glass floor walkway
Round-trip cruise to Greenwich, home of the Prime Meridian
See London from the water, from a bridge, and from a historic dockside town
Save compared to booking each experience separately
includes: Digital mobile tickets for all three
excludes: Greenwich attraction entry fees (Cutty Sark, Royal Observatory)
